content.title: Who Is Wyndham Clark's Girlfriend?
content.text: After some lean years after turning professional in 2017, Wyndham Clark shot to prominence in 2023, first with his maiden PGA Tour victory at the Wells Fargo Championship, then with his maiden Major title at the US Open.That saw him climb inside the world’s top 10 for the first time, while he also qualified automatically for the US Ryder Cup team, while in 2024, as well as continuing his upward trajectory on the course, he also appeared in the second series of Netflix docuseries Full Swing.Clark’s profile may never have been higher, but when it comes to his personal life, he remains relatively private.He had been dating Julia Kemmling, a former student at Quinnipiac University, who later became a Women's Golf Assistant Coach there.However, in more recent times, he has been seen at tournaments with Alicia Bogdanski, including his Major victory at Los Angeles Country Club and win at the 2024 Pebble Beach Pro-Am.According to Golf Digest, the pair were introduced through mutual friends at the end of 2021. Bogdanski attended Arizona State University and has a degree in psychology.In its September 2023 issue, in which Clark is its cover star, Bogdanski explains how her qualification has assisted the star, saying: “If I see him overthinking something, I try to pull him back down, getting grounded and making see things in perspective.”Subscribe to the Golf Monthly newsletter to stay up to date with all the latest tour news, equipment news, reviews, head-to-heads and buyer’s guides from our team of experienced experts.Per Golf.com, Bogdanski is currently employed by Discovery Land Company. Clark has also shared images of the couple on his official Instagram account.
